paras.text: (d) Draw the structural formulae for the following organic compounds;

paras.pashto: i. 2،4–ډای میتایل پېنټ–2–ینال   ii. 2،2–ډای میتایل بیوټانال

paras.text: Identify aldehydes and ketones in the laboratory tests.
paras.urdu: تجربہ گاہی ٹیسٹوں میں الڈیہائیڈز اور کیٹونز کی شناخت کریں۔
paras.pashto: په لابراتواري ازموینو کې الدیهایډونه او کیټونونه وپېژنئ.

paras.text: Add 50 mL of 0.1 M AgNO₃ to the beaker and add NH₄OH to this. A brown precipitate will form. Continue adding NH₄OH until the solution becomes clear. To this, add 25 mL of 0.8 M KOH. Again, add NH₄OH until solution becomes clear. To perform demonstration, add 5 mL of glucose solution to a flask (or test tube) and to this add 25 mL of Tollen’s reagent. Stopper the flask and swirl the solution so that the whole of the inner surface of the flask is wetted. The solution will turn yellow and brown then become cloudy and dark before silver begins to form on the inside of the flask. This should take a couple of minutes. When a satisfactory mirror has formed, rinse the flask and analyse the silver mirror.
paras.urdu: بیکر میں 0.1 M AgNO₃ کے 50 mL ڈالیں اور اس میں NH₄OH ملائیں۔ بھورا رسوب بنے گا۔ محلول صاف ہونے تک NH₄OH ملاتے رہیں۔ اس میں 0.8 M KOH کے 25 mL ڈالیں۔ پھر محلول صاف ہونے تک NH₄OH ملائیں۔ مظاہرے کے لیے ایک فلاسک (یا ٹیسٹ ٹیوب) میں گلوکوز محلول کے 5 mL ڈالیں اور اس میں ٹولن عامل کے 25 mL ملائیں۔ فلاسک پر ڈاٹ لگا کر محلول کو گھمائیں تاکہ فلاسک کی پوری اندرونی سطح گیلی ہو جائے۔ فلاسک کے اندر چاندی بننا شروع ہونے سے پہلے محلول پیلا اور بھورا ہو کر پھر دھندلا اور گہرا ہو جائے گا۔ اس میں چند منٹ لگیں گے۔ جب تسلی بخش آئینہ بن جائے تو فلاسک کو کھنگال کر چاندی کے آئینے کا تجزیہ کریں۔
paras.pashto: په بیکر کې د 0.1 M AgNO₃ 50 mL واچوئ او NH₄OH ورزیات کړئ. نسواري رسوب به جوړ شي. تر هغه NH₄OH ورزیاتوئ چې محلول روڼ شي. بیا د 0.8 M KOH 25 mL ورزیات کړئ. بیا تر هغه NH₄OH ورزیات کړئ چې محلول روڼ شي. د ښودنې لپاره په یوه فلاسک (یا ټیسټ ټیوب) کې د ګلوکوز محلول 5 mL واچوئ او د ټولن عامل 25 mL ورزیات کړئ. فلاسک بند کړئ او محلول وګرځوئ څو د فلاسک ټوله داخلي سطحه لانده شي. محلول به ژېړ او نسواري، بیا خړ او تیاره شي مخکې له دې چې د فلاسک دننه سپین زر جوړ شي. دا به څو دقیقې ونیسي. کله چې د قناعت وړ هینداره جوړه شوه، فلاسک ومینځئ او د سپینو زرو هینداره وڅېړئ.

(d) Draw the structural formulae for the following organic compounds;

i. 2,4–dimethylpent–2–enal   ii. 2,2–dimethylbutanal

iii. 3,3–dimethylhex–4–en–2–one   iv. 4–methylhex–5–en–3–one

v. pent–4–yn–2–one

Project

Identify aldehydes and ketones in the laboratory tests.

Add 50 mL of 0.1 M AgNO₃ to the beaker and add NH₄OH to this. A brown precipitate will form. Continue adding NH₄OH until the solution becomes clear. To this, add 25 mL of 0.8 M KOH. Again, add NH₄OH until solution becomes clear. To perform demonstration, add 5 mL of glucose solution to a flask (or test tube) and to this add 25 mL of Tollen’s reagent. Stopper the flask and swirl the solution so that the whole of the inner surface of the flask is wetted. The solution will turn yellow and brown then become cloudy and dark before silver begins to form on the inside of the flask. This should take a couple of minutes. When a satisfactory mirror has formed, rinse the flask and analyse the silver mirror.

sections.theory:
Unit 20 — Carbonyl Compounds 2: Carboxylic Acids and Functional Derivatives

After studying this unit, students will be able to:

Describe preparation of carboxylic acids by carbonation of Grignard’s Reagent, hydrolysis of nitriles, oxidation of primary alcohols, oxidation of aldehydes and oxidation of alkyl benzene. (Applying)

Discuss reactivity of carboxylic acids. (Applying)

Describe the chemistry of carboxylic acids by conversion to carboxylic acid derivatives i.e. acyl halides, acid anhydrides, esters, amides and reactions involving inter conversion of these. (Analyzing)

Describe reactions of carboxylic acid derivatives. (Applying)

Describe isomerism in carboxylic acids. (Understanding)

sections.content:
Unit 20 — Carbonyl Compounds 2: Carboxylic Acids and Functional Derivatives

After studying this unit, students will be able to:

Describe preparation of carboxylic acids by carbonation of Grignard’s Reagent, hydrolysis of nitriles, oxidation of primary alcohols, oxidation of aldehydes and oxidation of alkyl benzene. (Applying)

Discuss reactivity of carboxylic acids. (Applying)

Describe the chemistry of carboxylic acids by conversion to carboxylic acid derivatives i.e. acyl halides, acid anhydrides, esters, amides and reactions involving inter conversion of these. (Analyzing)

Describe reactions of carboxylic acid derivatives. (Applying)

Describe isomerism in carboxylic acids. (Understanding)
